description: This file defines the RecipeDetailFragment class, which is responsible for displaying detailed information about a recipe, including title, ingredients, steps, and actions for sharing and saving. It handles lifecycle events, UI setup, and interactions with the DataRepository.

classes.name: RecipeDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays detailed information about a specific recipe, allowing sharing and toggling favorite status.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the DataRepository instance when the fragment attaches to its context.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe ID passed via arguments during fragment creation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout and sets up UI components; loads recipe data asynchronously and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RecipeDetailFragment with the specified recipe ID.
